verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state the exact story: "Assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request. Use comments to refine, iterate, approve and merge—all directly within GitHub Mobile," plus Agent Tasks management for tracking cloud agent progress on mobile. Community evidence largely covers unrelated mobile app issues (notifications, links, review UI) rather than disputing the agent-assignment workflow itself. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the assign-to-Copilot-and-get-PR flow specifically on mobile.
